name: Revenge ~Yuganda Fukushuu~
source:
Main character gets out of prison after sentence for failed rape attempt. He swears to have revenge over the victim woman and prepares the worst imaginable insult.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
主角因强奸未遂入狱，刑满获释后，发誓要报复当年的受害女子，为她准备了最为恶劣的凌辱。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/07/vn-of-month-january-2004-paradise-lost.html]vndbreview[/url]]
